notice: Career guides describe common duties and skills. They are not advertisements for live vacancies.

roles.title: Baker
roles.summary: Prepare breads, pastries and baked goods; manage dough, ovens, food safety and production timing.

roles.title: Butcher
roles.summary: Prepare and portion meat, maintain safe temperatures, manage displays and advise customers on cuts.

roles.title: Chef / Cook
roles.summary: Prepare meals, coordinate kitchen service, manage ingredients and maintain hygiene standards.

roles.title: Bartender
roles.summary: Prepare beverages, serve guests, manage bar stock and follow responsible service rules.

roles.title: Hotel Receptionist
roles.summary: Welcome guests, manage reservations and coordinate check-in, check-out and guest requests.

roles.title: Waiter / Waitress
roles.summary: Welcome guests, explain menus, take orders and coordinate food and beverage service while maintaining service and hygiene standards.

roles.title: Bricklayer / Mason
roles.summary: Build and repair walls and structures using masonry materials, drawings and site safety procedures.

roles.title: Electrician
roles.summary: Install, inspect and repair electrical systems while following local electrical codes and safety rules.

roles.title: Carpenter
roles.summary: Measure, cut and install wood structures, fixtures and fittings for construction or renovation projects.

roles.title: Welder
roles.summary: Join metal components using approved welding processes and inspect finished joints for quality.

roles.title: Construction Site Supervisor
roles.summary: Coordinate site teams, schedules, materials and safety procedures to keep projects on track.

roles.title: Plumber
roles.summary: Install, maintain and repair water, drainage and heating pipework while following local codes and safety procedures.

roles.title: HVAC Technician
roles.summary: Install, inspect and service heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems, diagnose faults and document maintenance.

roles.title: Painter / Decorator
roles.summary: Prepare surfaces and apply paint, coatings or decorative finishes to residential and commercial properties.

roles.title: Factory Production Operator
roles.summary: Operate production equipment, follow work instructions and record output and quality checks.

roles.title: Assembly Technician
roles.summary: Assemble components and finished products using tools, technical instructions and inspection steps.

roles.title: Quality Control Inspector
roles.summary: Inspect materials and finished goods, document defects and support corrective actions.

roles.title: Delivery Driver / Courier
roles.summary: Collect and deliver goods safely, plan routes and maintain accurate delivery records.

roles.title: Truck Driver
roles.summary: Transport cargo over local or long-distance routes while meeting safety and delivery requirements.

roles.title: Warehouse Operative
roles.summary: Receive, store, pick, pack and dispatch goods using inventory procedures and warehouse equipment.

roles.title: Logistics Coordinator
roles.summary: Coordinate shipments, carriers, schedules and documentation across supply-chain operations.

roles.title: Administrative Assistant
roles.summary: Support daily office operations, correspondence, records, scheduling and internal coordination.

roles.title: Secretary / Executive Assistant
roles.summary: Manage calendars, meetings, travel and correspondence for managers or executive teams.

roles.title: Data Entry Clerk
roles.summary: Enter, validate and maintain business information accurately across digital systems.

roles.title: Human Resources Assistant
roles.summary: Support recruitment administration, employee records, onboarding and HR coordination.

roles.title: Operations Manager
roles.summary: Coordinate teams, processes, resources and performance indicators to improve business operations.

roles.title: Project Manager
roles.summary: Plan project scope, schedules, resources, risks and stakeholder communication through delivery.

roles.title: Sales Representative
roles.summary: Explain products or services to prospective customers, manage enquiries and maintain sales records.

roles.title: Account Manager
roles.summary: Maintain business relationships, coordinate customer needs and support account growth and retention.

roles.title: Retail Sales Assistant
roles.summary: Assist customers, maintain product displays, process transactions and replenish store stock.

roles.title: Cashier
roles.summary: Process purchases and payments, balance transactions and provide courteous customer assistance.

roles.title: Customer Support Agent
roles.summary: Resolve customer questions through approved phone, email or chat channels and document outcomes.

roles.title: Cleaner / Housekeeper
roles.summary: Clean and maintain homes, offices or hospitality spaces using appropriate products and procedures.

roles.title: Sanitation Worker
roles.summary: Support public or private sanitation operations, waste collection and environmental cleanliness.

roles.title: Waste Management Operative
roles.summary: Collect, sort or process waste and recyclables in line with environmental and safety rules.

roles.title: Security Officer
roles.summary: Monitor premises, control access, report incidents and follow site security procedures.

roles.title: Bodyguard / Close Protection Officer
roles.summary: Provide protective support following lawful risk assessments, professional training and local licensing requirements.

roles.title: DJ
roles.summary: Prepare and perform music sets for events, coordinate with organisers and manage audio equipment.

roles.title: Live Sound / Lighting Technician
roles.summary: Set up, operate and troubleshoot sound and lighting systems for live events and venues.

roles.title: Registered Nurse
roles.summary: Provide patient care, monitor clinical conditions and document treatment within professional scope and local licensing.

roles.title: Medical Receptionist
roles.summary: Coordinate appointments, patient enquiries and administrative records while protecting confidentiality.

roles.title: Care Assistant
roles.summary: Support people with daily living activities under care plans and applicable local training requirements.

roles.title: School Teacher
roles.summary: Plan and deliver lessons, assess learning and support students in line with curriculum requirements.

roles.title: Tutor
roles.summary: Provide individual or small-group learning support and adapt explanations to student needs.

roles.title: Corporate Trainer
roles.summary: Design and deliver workplace training, evaluate learning outcomes and maintain course materials.

roles.title: Bookkeeper
roles.summary: Maintain financial records, reconcile transactions and prepare routine accounting information.

roles.title: Accountant
roles.summary: Prepare financial statements, analyse records and support tax and compliance processes under local rules.

roles.title: Payroll Specialist
roles.summary: Process payroll data, verify deductions and maintain accurate employee pay records.

roles.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
roles.summary: Plan and measure online campaigns across search, social, email and other digital channels.

roles.title: Social Media Manager
roles.summary: Plan channel calendars, publish approved content and monitor audience engagement and performance.

roles.title: Graphic Designer
roles.summary: Create visual assets for digital and print use while following brand systems and project briefs.

roles.title: Software Developer
roles.summary: Design, build, test and maintain software applications and services.

roles.title: IT Support Technician
roles.summary: Diagnose hardware, software and network issues and help users restore reliable service.

roles.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
roles.summary: Monitor security alerts, investigate incidents and support vulnerability and risk management.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.summary: Prepare, analyse and communicate data using queries, spreadsheets and visualisation tools.

roles.title: Systems Administrator
roles.summary: Maintain servers, user access, backups, networks and system availability.

roles.title: Mechanical Engineer
roles.summary: Design, analyse and improve mechanical systems, equipment and components.

roles.title: Civil Engineer
roles.summary: Plan, design or supervise infrastructure and construction works in line with local standards.

roles.title: Automation Technician
roles.summary: Install and maintain industrial control systems, sensors and automated equipment.

roles.title: Farm Worker
roles.summary: Support planting, harvesting, animal care or general farm operations according to seasonal needs.

roles.title: Agricultural Technician
roles.summary: Collect field data and support crop, soil, irrigation or livestock management programmes.

roles.title: Horticulture Worker
roles.summary: Grow and maintain plants, landscapes or nursery stock using suitable cultivation techniques.

roles.title: Hairdresser / Barber
roles.summary: Consult with clients and provide hair cutting, styling and grooming services within local licensing rules.

roles.title: Beauty Therapist
roles.summary: Provide permitted beauty treatments, maintain hygiene and explain aftercare to clients.

roles.title: Legal Assistant
roles.summary: Support legal professionals with document preparation, research, scheduling and case administration.

roles.title: Compliance Analyst
roles.summary: Help monitor internal controls, regulatory obligations and compliance documentation.

roles.title: Video Editor
roles.summary: Edit footage, audio and graphics into finished video content for digital or broadcast use.

roles.title: 3D Artist
roles.summary: Create 3D models, materials, lighting and renders for games, products or visual media.

roles.title: Photographer
roles.summary: Plan and capture images, manage lighting and deliver edited visual material to clients.

roles.title: Remote Software Developer
roles.summary: Build and maintain software with distributed teams using online collaboration and version-control tools.

roles.title: Remote Graphic Designer
roles.summary: Create digital brand and marketing assets remotely, working from briefs and feedback cycles.

roles.title: Remote Customer Support Agent
roles.summary: Assist customers by phone, email or chat from an approved remote location and document each case.

roles.title: Remote Virtual Assistant
roles.summary: Provide remote scheduling, inbox, research and administrative support to a business or professional.

roles.title: Remote Translator
roles.summary: Translate or localise documents and digital content while preserving meaning, tone and terminology.

roles.title: Remote UX/UI Designer
roles.summary: Research user needs and design accessible digital interfaces, prototypes and interaction flows.

roles.title: Remote Digital Marketing Specialist
roles.summary: Manage digital campaigns and performance reporting across distributed marketing teams.

roles.title: Remote Administrative Assistant
roles.summary: Provide remote scheduling, document, inbox and coordination support using approved cloud-based office systems.

roles.title: Remote Web Designer
roles.summary: Design and maintain websites and responsive pages remotely, translating briefs into accessible visual layouts.

roles.title: Remote Data Analyst
roles.summary: Analyse business or research data from an approved remote location and deliver dashboards and concise reports.

roles.title: Remote Technical Support Specialist
roles.summary: Diagnose software and device issues through remote support tools, ticketing systems and clear user guidance.

roles.title: Remote Content Writer
roles.summary: Research and write original digital content to editorial briefs, style guides and publication schedules.

roles.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
roles.summary: Identify and qualify potential customers, conduct initial outreach and arrange sales conversations for the commercial team.

roles.title: Account Executive
roles.summary: Manage qualified opportunities, understand buyer needs, present solutions and guide prospects through the sales process.

roles.title: Business Development Manager
roles.summary: Develop new commercial relationships, identify markets and partnerships and build a qualified pipeline for growth.

roles.title: Key Account Manager
roles.summary: Maintain strategic customer relationships, coordinate service needs and identify retention and account-growth opportunities.

roles.title: Sales Operations Specialist
roles.summary: Improve sales processes, reporting, CRM data quality and coordination between sales, marketing and finance.

roles.title: Research Scientist
roles.summary: Plan and conduct structured research, analyse results and communicate findings in a laboratory, academic or industrial setting.

roles.title: Laboratory Technician
roles.summary: Prepare samples, operate laboratory equipment, maintain records and support testing under documented procedures.

roles.title: Clinical Research Associate
roles.summary: Support clinical study sites, monitor documentation and help ensure trial activities follow approved protocols and regulations.

roles.title: Environmental Scientist
roles.summary: Collect and interpret environmental data, assess impacts and support conservation, compliance or remediation projects.

roles.title: Biotechnologist
roles.summary: Apply biological and laboratory techniques to research or production in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, food or related industries.

roles.title: Research Data Analyst
roles.summary: Clean, analyse and visualise research datasets and help teams interpret evidence and communicate results.

roles.title: Public Administration Officer
roles.summary: Process public-service requests, maintain official records and coordinate administrative work under applicable procedures.

roles.title: Public Health Inspector
roles.summary: Inspect facilities and practices, document findings and support public-health and sanitation requirements within local authority.

roles.title: Social Services Caseworker
roles.summary: Assess service needs, coordinate referrals and maintain case records while following safeguarding and confidentiality rules.

roles.title: Emergency Services Dispatcher
roles.summary: Receive urgent calls, gather essential information and coordinate responses with emergency-service teams.

roles.title: Municipal Services Technician
roles.summary: Support the operation and maintenance of public infrastructure, facilities or local services using approved procedures.
